title: Blood Collection and Serum Preparation in Mice
author: Amandine EVEN

steps.title: Anesthetize mice intraperitoneally
steps.instruction: Inject each mouse intraperitoneally with sodium pentobarbital at 100 mg per kg body weight.

steps.title: Collect blood via cardiac puncture
steps.instruction: Using a 1 mL syringe fitted with a 21‑gauge needle, perform cardiac puncture to draw blood; this terminal step is done immediately before euthanasia or tissue harvest.

steps.title: Allow blood to clot
steps.instruction: Transfer the blood into a dry 1.6 mL Eppendorf tube and let it clot at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge to separate serum
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the clotting tube at 2000 × g, 4 °C, for 15 minutes to recover the serum.

steps.title: Store serum at -80 °C
steps.instruction: Aliquot the serum and keep it at –80 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Dilute serum and label samples
steps.instruction: For multiplex cytokine assays, mix serum 1:1 with PBS pH 7.5 (2‑fold dilution) before freezing; label each aliquot with unique animal and group identifiers and store under conditions recommended by the assay provider.
